description: Source code implementing wildcard command expansion and processing for Zephyr shell module, including functions for adding commands, expanding wildcards, and preparing command buffers.

methods.name: command_add
methods.description: Adds a command to the buffer if space permits, replacing a pattern match.

methods.name: commands_expand
methods.description: Searches command tree for matches to a wildcard pattern and adds them to buffer.

methods.name: z_shell_has_wildcard
methods.description: Checks if a string contains wildcard characters '?' or '*'.

methods.name: z_shell_wildcard_prepare
methods.description: Prepares command buffer for wildcard expansion by copying and trimming.

methods.name: z_shell_wildcard_process
methods.description: Processes wildcard patterns in commands, expanding matches.

methods.name: z_shell_wildcard_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes command buffer after wildcard expansion by copying temporary buffer back.
